newsitem.title: USA: Suspected serial killer was prostitute, mother says.
newsitem.headline: Suspected serial killer was prostitute, mother says.

text.p: Andrew Cunanan, a suspect in a series of killings in several states, supported his lavish lifestyle by being a "high-class homosexual prostitute," the Chicago Sun-Times Monday quoted his mother as saying.

Mary Ann Cunanan, who lived in public housing in Eureka, Illinois, and was described by the newspaper as "very distraught," told the Sun-Times her son "traveled in high-class circles." She laughed when asked if he had ever visited the central Illinois town.

She hung up when asked how she knew that Cunanan, 27, was a male prostitute, the newspaper reported. Several friends of Cunanan have said he was gregarious and led a free-spending lifestyle but did not hold down a regular job.

Meanwhile, a bookstore owner in Cunanan's home town of San Diego said he was misquoted when he was alleged to have told the Minneapolis Star Tribune that Cunanan and the son of one of his alleged victims were "close."

Bruce Kerschner told the newspaper that he had only heard of a friendship between Cunanan and Duke Miglin, a 25-year-old aspiring actor in Los Angeles and son of slain Chicago real estate mogul Lee Miglin.
A spokesman for the Miglin family reiterated the family's contention that there was no apparent link between Miglin and Cunanan.
Miglin, 72, was found stabbed and slashed to death May 3 in his Chicago garage. Parked nearby was a vehicle belonging to one of two men Cunanan was suspected of killing in the Minneapolis area.

An intense police manhunt was under way for Cunanan along the East Coast following the killing Friday of a cemetery caretaker in New Jersey, whose red pickup truck was missing and presumed stolen by the killer.
